claims.text: The bureau-hosted account distinguishes earlier Yanjing administration, renaming and palace construction; its author and publication year remain unresolved. The Nanjing accounts describe Jiankang’s prefectural/military offices and later palace occupation. Completion of principal imperial buildings is not the later 1283 city completion or royal move. Name, construction and occupation do not establish simultaneous identical government or empty land.

recall.question: Why does the account’s 1276 construction date not establish identical government at Yanjing and Jiankang?
options: The date concerns principal imperial buildings, not identical city government.
Completing imperial buildings proves the whole city and all its offices were complete.
recall.why: It concerns principal imperial buildings, while Jiankang’s sources describe offices and palace occupation; the account’s 1283 city completion is outside the endpoint.

care: Host is not author; principal imperial buildings is not whole city.1283 remains unselected, with no empty-land or propaganda-as-assent inference.
